summary: IPurchaseService backed by Unity IAP 5 (App Store, Google Play). Replaces FakePurchaseService.
manualSteps: Link the project to a Unity Cloud project (Edit ▸ Project Settings ▸ Services) — Unity IAP 5 initializes Unity Gaming Services before it connects the store

Give every sellable product in Resources/Config/products.json a "type": "Consumable" or "NonConsumable" (absent ⇒ Consumable). A product that must survive a restore (remove-ads, a starter pack) is NonConsumable AND grants an entitlement

App Store Connect → In-App Purchases: create one product per products.json id (the id is the Product ID, verbatim), with the matching type (Consumable / Non-Consumable), price and localization; sign the Paid Applications agreement

Google Play Console → Monetize ▸ In-app products: create one product per products.json id (the id is the Product ID, verbatim) and activate it; upload a build to a testing track with the BILLING permission and add license testers
Drag UnityIapInstaller.asset into the game-installer slot on RootLifetimeScope (Master Scene)
iOS only: draw a Restore Purchases button that calls IPurchaseService.RestoreAsync (App Review requires one for non-consumables)
